d: Watch the match highlights and all goals from South Africa vs Canada in the Round of 32 of the FIFA World Cup 2026 at Los Angeles Stadium in Los Angeles, California. Despite resilient defending and key stops from Ronwen Williams in a tense knockout clash, Stephen Eustáquio scored a dramatic stoppage-time winner in the 90+2nd minute to seal a 1-0 victory and send Canada into the Round of 16.
